text:
October was **$1,140 higher** than September. Three things did most of it:

- **Flight to Denver** on the 4th: $486
- **Rent** went up $150 from the 1st
- **Eating out** two weekends running: $310 more than usual

Everything else was within $40 of September.
move my netflix bill to the 15th
Done. Netflix is now due on **November 15**, and it shows under *Due this week* only from the 12th.
let me add a note to each bill
Each bill now has a **Note** line under its name. Tap it to write something, like *"cancel after the trial"*. Notes are saved with the page.
